card.name: Coronary in CABG contraindication phrase
card.fires_on: The word "coronary" right after "in the setting of" in NSAID contraindication statements about bypass surgery. Also "as" after "such" when a list of named bowel diseases follows.

modes.label: CABG contraindication
modes.description: "coronary" after "contraindicated in the setting of", leading into "artery bypass graft (CABG)".
modes.example: Nabumetone tablets are contraindicated in the setting of<< coronary>> artery bypass graft (CABG)

modes.label: Such as before diseases
modes.example: severe inflammatory conditions of the intestinal tract such<< as>> Crohn’s disease, ulcerative col

card.plain: It marks the word "coronary" in the standard NSAID warning about heart bypass surgery.
